country: European Union and its Member States
summary: Restoration pledges target measures on at least 20% of EU land and 20% of sea areas by 2030, with measures in place for all ecosystems needing restoration by 2050; identified mitigation potential includes 51–54 Mt CO2-eq/year from rewetting peatlands and wetlands and 8–235 Mt CO2-eq/year from biodiversity-respecting reforestation and sustainable forest management. Across conservation and restoration, the LULUCF sector is to deliver 310 Mt CO2-eq of net removals by 2030—42 Mt CO2-eq more than the 2016–2018 average—with binding national targets across Member States. Agricultural measures target 19 Mt CO2-eq/year in avoided nitrous oxide emissions through better fertiliser efficiency. For 2023–2027, 40% of Common Agricultural Policy financing is intended to support climate objectives, including at least 25% of annual Pillar I direct-payment funds for eco-schemes and at least 35% of Pillar II funds for environmental and climate activities.
